summary: Turn your Kobo into a remote control for your computer.
page_description: Pair with your computer and run favorite actions from large, clear controls.
release_notes: Acknowledge a command under the deck when it finishes, instead of only when its pad is tapped again.

steps.text: Create ~/.config/kobo/sidekick/deck.toml with the pages and controls you want on the reader.
Initialize the companion daemon to obtain its address, certificate, and pairing code.
Install the daemon certificate on the Kobo before pairing.
